articles.title: Independence Day 2026 LIVE: India celebrates its 80th Independence Day; PM Modi extends greetings and pays tribute to freedom fighters
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi is set to lead India's 80th Independence Day celebrations from the iconic Red Fort in Delhi in 2026. This significant national event underscores the nation's progress and sovereignty. Aspirants should note the PM's address, which often outlines key national achievements, future visions, and challenges, reinforcing India's strategic direction and commitment to its citizens, reflecting on the journey since independence.

articles.title: Independence Day 2026: PM Modi hails freedom fighters, says their dreams inspire Viksit Bharat
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi paid tribute to India's freedom fighters on Independence Day, acknowledging their immense courage, sacrifice, and commitment to ending colonial rule. He emphasized that their enduring spirit continues to inspire the nation. This annual address highlights the foundational values of India's independence movement and its ongoing significance for the country.

articles.title: Submersible drone analyzes ice
articles.summary: Activities on frozen lakes, like car racing and ice skating, inherently carry significant risks despite their annual popularity. While these events attract enthusiasts, the volatile nature of ice necessitates strict safety protocols. Robust precautions are paramount to mitigate potential hazards and ensure participant safety, preventing accidents on these picturesque yet dangerous venues. Vigilance and adherence to guidelines are crucial for safe execution.
